newsitem.title: BOSNIA: TABLE - Bosnia July industrial prices up 0.2 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Bosnia July industrial prices up 0.2 pct m/m.

text.p: The Statistics Bureau of Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation issued the following economic indicator details on Friday.
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCER PRICES JULY JUNE JULY 96

NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of Bosnia-Herzegovina territory. Data for the country's Serb entity covering the remaining 49 percent are not available. Industrial producer prices in the federation in the Jan-July 1997 period rose 5.0 percent compared with the same period in 1996, the office said. -- Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
